{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
qc_failed = data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999
num_qc_failed = qc_failed.sum()

# Deduplicate on patient_id: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
# First, create a mask for the max sample_seq per patient
patient_max_sample_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].transform('max')
data['is_max_sample_seq'] = data['sample_seq'] == patient_max_sample_seq

# Keep only the rows with the highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data[data['is_max_sample_seq']]

# Count the number of unique patients in the deduplicated data
num_enrolled_patients = deduplicated_data['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print the numbers we need for evidence
print(num_qc_failed)
print(num_enrolled_patients)"}
